source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.2, kinetic theory of gases (PDF 5-6).

blocks.text: Kinetic theory of gases batati hai ke gas kin molecules se bani hai aur woh kaise harkat karte hain. Is theory mein gas ka pressure (dabao) particles ke aapas mein aur bartan (container) ki deewaron se takrane se paida hota hai. Yeh theory temperature, volume (hajm) aur pressure jaisi properties, aur transport properties (cheezein aage pohanchane wali khasiyatein) jaise viscosity, thermal conductivity (hararat guzarne ki salahiyat) aur diffusivity (phailne ki salahiyat) bhi samjhati hai.
Kinetic molecular theory ideal gases par lagu hoti hai aur pichhli class mein parhai ja chuki hai. Phir bhi is ke bunyadi assumptions (mafrooze) yeh hain:

items: Gas bohat zyada tadaad mein nanhe, gol (spherical) particles se bani hai jo apne size ke muqable mein ek doosre se bohat door hain.
Gas ke particles hamesha tez harkat mein hain, har taraf be-tarteeb (random) simton mein.
Gas ke particles ki bartan ki deewaron se takkarein bilkul elastic hain (kinetic energy zaya nahi hoti).
Jab tak particles aapas mein takrayein nahi, un ke darmiyan na kashish (attraction) hai na dhakelne wali force (repulsion).
Gas ke particles ki average kinetic energy gas ke temperature par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Hawa ke ek chhote se 'cube' mein 10²⁰ tak molecules ho sakte hain. Gas ke particles ka apna volume un ke beech khali jagah ke volume ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar (negligible) hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Mean free path woh average faasla hai jo harkat karta particle aisi takkar se pehle tay karta hai jo us ki simt (direction) ya energy ko kaafi badal de.

blocks.prompt: Kinetic theory ka kaun sa mafrooza batata hai ke gas apna poora bartan kyun bhar deti hai?
blocks.explanation: Zarrat musalsal, tez, be-tarteeb harkat mein hain aur (takkar ke ilawa) aik doosre ko nahi kheenchte, is liye tamam dastyab jagah mein phail jate hain.

items: Kinetic theory: gas ka pressure particles ki takkaron se.
Assumptions: nanhe door door particles, random tez harkat, elastic takkarein, takkar ke ilawa koi force nahi, average K.E. temperature par munhasir.
Mean free path: do bari takkaron ke darmiyan average faasla.
